controls.target_definition: Road<->Lane cells where cached current argmax differs from cached GT argmax

derivation.condition: For target scorer cell u and target class c, a camera-plane paint guarantees the input-plane part of a flip only if all private support pixels of u are moved so the resized RGB x'_u has target-class logit margin m_c(x') > 0 under the regional SegNet stem. Private support controls x'_u, but it does not isolate the downstream receptive field, so the sufficient condition is a coherent neighborhood whose induced feature response clears the class margin.

source_facts.D_private_supports: scale 874/384 and 1164/512 are both >2, giving disjoint 2x2 camera supports per scorer-grid pixel for align_corners=False bilinear resize
source_facts.PoseNet_preprocess: upstream/modules.py PoseNet.preprocess_input resizes both RGB frames to 384x512 then rgb_to_yuv6
source_facts.SegNet_frame: upstream/modules.py SegNet.preprocess_input uses only frame_1 then bilinear resize to 384x512

taxonomy_prediction.R_attenuation: Private supports make bilinear-D exact at edited scorer pixels; predicted not to explain cg3/se2 failure.
taxonomy_prediction.amplitude_timidity: Low max_delta paints fail if full-color same-radius paint corrects the cell.
taxonomy_prediction.receptive_field_veto: Full-color private-support paint still fails because the stride-2/regional SegNet context vetoes the local color.
taxonomy_prediction.uint8_floor: Only active when requested camera deltas round to no byte movement; measured as zero for emitted delta>=1 paints.
